test_title: PYST 08: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Change the following sentence into positive degree.

Yash is not better than Harsh.

options.text: Yash is as good as Harsh.
Yash and Harsh both are good.
Yash is not good than Harsh.

solution:
The correct alternative in positive degree is **'2'** i.e. **Yash is as good as Harsh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The positive degree compares two equals using **"as ... as" **structure.
 
• The original sentence, “Yash is not better than Harsh,” means they are equal in quality.

The other options contain the following errors:

 
• **Option 1:** "Yash is best than Harsh" is incorrect because "best" is the superlative form and "than" is used for comparative degree.
 
• **Option 3:** "Yash and Harsh both are good" does not imply equality between the two in the same precise manner as the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4: **"Yash is not good than Harsh" is grammatically incorrect because "good" should be in the comparative form "better" when used with "than."

**Correct sentence:** *Yash is as good as Harsh*.
